name: langfuse
description: Instrument, evaluate, and manage LLM applications with the open-source Langfuse platform.

interface.shortDescription: Trace, evaluate, and manage prompts for LLM apps with Langfuse.
interface.longDescription: Work with Langfuse from Caeros: instrument Python and JS applications with the OpenTelemetry-based SDKs (decorators, spans, generations, framework integrations), manage versioned prompts with labels and caching, and run evaluations with scores, LLM-as-a-judge, datasets, and experiments. Includes setup guidance for Langfuse Cloud and self-hosting, plus Langfuse's public Docs MCP server for always-current documentation lookups.
defaultPrompt: Add Langfuse tracing to my Python LLM pipeline
Move my hardcoded prompts into Langfuse prompt management with a production label
Set up an LLM-as-a-judge evaluator and a dataset experiment in Langfuse
